_: affan-afterhours SFX — a TRACK-MAP override only. The sound vocabulary (which sound lands on which motion class, its slices and its level band) is house-wide and lives in presets/youtube/default/sfx.json; change it THERE. This file exists because this channel's timeline is laid out differently: the creator places their own Epidemic music on A2 themselves, so every SFX layer shifts up one and the music role points at the track they already own.

tracks._: 0-based audio track indices for THIS channel: SFX on A3/A4/A5. The creator lays their own music and it does NOT live on a reserved track — on the shipped Travis explainer (2026-09-20) it went on A7, ABOVE these SFX, and A2 stayed empty. Read every audio track before planning sound; `music` below is only a hint for the music pass, which the creator normally runs themselves.

targets_dbfs._: THIS CHANNEL RUNS 2 dB UNDER THE HOUSE BANDS. The youtube/default numbers were measured on a job with NO music bed; Affan Afterhours always has one, and the creator lays it themselves on A2, so the master sums voice + music + SFX. At the house bands the mix peaked at +0.008 dBFS (measured on the first full export, 2026-09-16) - over full scale, against YouTube's -1 dBTP. Two dB off every band puts the peak under -1 without touching the creator's music or the measured voice chain.
targets_dbfs._overlay_pass: ADDED 2026-09-17 for the Higgsfield-overlay pass. The house bands above are for MOTION-GRAPHIC events (a card rising, a chip popping). A reenactment overlay needs DIEGETIC sound - the room it is in - and that sits far lower, because it plays under narration AND the creator's music. `ambience` is room tone and machine hum, `walla` is crowd murmur, `spot` is a visible action (a key, a mouse, a page, a chair), `accent` is an action that punctuates (a stamp, a shutter, a phone). A bed at the -20 `bed` band reads as tape hiss; at -30 it is felt and not heard.

overlay_beds._: A BED IS CONTINUOUS ACROSS A RUN. Consecutive overlays in the same environment share ONE bed cue - restarting a room tone on every four-second clip pumps and reads as a mistake. Merge when the gap is under 0.6 s and the environment matches; a machine-hum layer does not break a room-tone run. On Hot Coffee this turned 59 overlay instances into 26 bed runs.
